newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK sells $40 mln in forward trading - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BOK sells $40 mln in forward trading - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) intervened in the interbank won/dollar market by selling $40 million in forward trading during Thursday's mid-morning session, dealers said.
Dealers said the BOK stepped in when the dollar hit 887.00 in the three-month forward contract and 899.00 in the six-month.

But the intervention failed to help the local currency rise in spot trading, and the underlying market sentiment toward the dollar continued to remain bullish in line with the U.S. unit's jump against the yen in world markets.
The won stood at 873.30 in spot trading in the first hour of business after opening at 870.00. It once touched a new 84-month low of 873.70.
